reasons.correctness: Port, properties with prefix currency.fixed-rates, adapter with case-insensitive match and PLN=1, and toPln with HALF_UP to 2 decimals are all present. BusinessRuleTranslatableException carries key and ISO code. Hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: CurrencyConversionService imports FixedExchangeRateAdapter, so the service references an adapter class. Test command was -Dtest=X, not the new CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest. i18n keys are in both files, constructor injection is used, port/adapter packages are correct.
reasons.design_fit: Cohesive currency package with port, adapter and service, reusing BusinessRuleTranslatableException. The leftover adapter import in the service leaks the adapter into the converting code. The adapter loops over entries where a normalized lookup would do.
reasons.test_quality: MockitoExtension, no Spring context. Covers HALF_UP rounding, the missing-rate key, and adapter case-insensitivity, PLN and unknown code. Does not assert the ISO-code argument. Adapter test sits in the service test class under unit/service.
reasons.graph_use: One generic query (MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.file_path LIMIT 1) that found neither the currency package nor an adapter example. Only CompanyRegistryPort was read. No existing adapter or TranslatableException usage was checked before writing.
